global_config_requirement: EVERY element must be a configurable component driven by a central config file (e.g., src/config/site.js). No hardcoded content in components. All text must be in Italian.

rules: Use soft warm neutrals for structure.
Accent color (#F2542D) used SPARINGLY for primary CTAs and magnetic buttons only.
Never use generic full-screen gradients. Keep backgrounds solid and premium.
Use line-by-line Framer Motion reveal for hero text.

layouts.spacing_strategy: Generous Spacing Philosophy (p-8 to p-32). Mobile-first. Let elements breathe.

homepage.hero: 100vh height. 3D interactive phone case (R3F) takes center/right. Left side: masked line-by-line text reveal (Italian), CTA overlay. Subtle parallax.
homepage.how_it_feels: Scroll-driven section. Sticky left side with text. Right side showing a 3D nose or large image pressing down as user scrolls.
homepage.best_sellers: Horizontal carousel. Product cards have 3D tilt on hover (framer-motion), price, discount badge, star rating.
homepage.social_proof: Editorial Ribbon marquee. Pale background, dark earthy text, massive gaps. Aggregated rating, customers count, trust logos.
homepage.video_reviews: Horizontal carousel of vertical 9:16 video cards. Play button overlay, stars, name.
homepage.brand_story: Numbered manifesto chapters. Massive 1-column layout with huge numerals and negative space, revealing on scroll. Large cinematic image.
homepage.footer: Generous padding (py-32). Newsletter, payment icons, shipping/returns info. Big typography for logo/CTA.

product_page.structure: Split layout on desktop: Sticky gallery on left, scrolling buy box on right. Mobile: Stacked.
product_page.gallery: Main image with zoom on hover. Thumbnails below/side. Floating Trustpilot-style review badge overlay (top-left).
buy_box: Title and Trustpilot star row (scrolls to reviews on click).
Price block: Strikethrough original price, red discount badge.
Coupon Card: Premium dashed border (border-black/20), shimmer effect, 'APPLY' button (triggers confetti), live 15-min countdown.
Model Selector: Searchable (using Shadcn Combobox/Command pattern modified to look like chips), brand -> families -> model logic. Pinned recent/popular.
Color Variants: Swatches. Displays per-variant star rating.
Quantity and Magnetic 'Acquista Ora' / 'Aggiungi al Carrello' buttons. Sold-out state handling.
Accordions: What's included, materials, compatibility, care, shipping (using shadcn accordion).
product_page.reviews_section: Trustpilot widget with distribution bars. Text reviews carousel. Video reviews row with fullscreen player.
product_page.faq: Accordion list specifically for phone-case questions.

motion.scroll: Lenis smooth scrolling is MANDATORY. Give it momentum.
motion.reveal: Framer-motion scroll-reveals (fade-and-rise) on all major sections.
motion.micro_interactions: Magnetic buttons, cursor-follow effects (e.g., custom cursor saying 'Squeeze' over 3D model).
motion.tactile_3d: Clicking the nose in 3D scene triggers an elastic spring squish animation + hint animation on load.
motion.coupon: Confetti burst on successful coupon application.

visual_enhancers.borders_and_shadows: Quiet luxury: 1px subtle borders (border-black/5), diffuse ambient shadows (shadow-sm). No heavy box-shadows.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grain texture overlay on the background to make it feel tactile and organic.
visual_enhancers.trustpilot: Maintain recognizable green star squares (#00B67A) for instant trust.
visual_enhancers.klarna: Maintain official pink logo styling (#FFA8C5) on the instalments line.

implementation_steps: Mock the phone case using a Box geometry with rounded corners in R3F.
Map a texture (animal face) to the front face.
Place a Sphere or Capsule geometry positioned exactly at the 'nose' of the animal.
Use framer-motion-3d or react-spring to animate the scaleZ and scaleX/Y of the nose onPointerDown to simulate a satisfying squish.
3d_libraries.lighting: Ensure scene is well-lit with ambientLight and directionalLight to show off the premium 'silicone' material.

media.rules: Clip frames, spotlight treatments, avoid plain rectangles where possible. Use sophisticated image masking.

component_instructions.html_vs_shadcn: Use raw HTML/Tailwind for marketing layouts (Hero, Bento grids). Use Shadcn JS components heavily customized for Accordions, Select, Carousel, Sheet (Cart), and Dialog.
component_instructions.cart: Implement a slide-out cart drawer using Shadcn Sheet. Include mock totals and a mock checkout button.
component_instructions.file_extensions: Use .jsx or .js for React components. Do not use .tsx.

instructions_to_main_agent: You MUST build this as a configurable platform. Create a central config object (e.g., src/config/site.js) containing ALL Italian text, product variants, price info, FAQs, etc.
Translate all placeholders to premium Italian (e.g., 'Aggiungi al Carrello', 'Come si sente', 'I più venduti'). Prices in EUR.
Focus heavily on the 'Buy Box' UX. It must feel extremely high-end, utilizing the requested features (Klarna, Coupon, Searchable model selector, Delivery countdown).
In the 3D scene, ensure lighting is good. The 'squish' interaction is the MVP feature; make the spring animation feel satisfying and elastic.
Strictly follow the color palette. No cheap gradients. Use pure #F7F5F2 for backgrounds and #FFFFFF for cards/buybox. Accent #F2542D for main CTA.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur). DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., `transition: all`). This breaks transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts (located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js or equivalent JS).
